name: Headpat for My Grumpy Sweetheart
original_name: 摸摸头，治愈你，重逢后炸毛竹马宠疯了
overview: As a child recovering in a sanatorium, Gu Xiuyuan meets Xiao Cao, a warm-hearted girl separated from her family who possesses a mysterious gift for healing—one that restores not only his spirit, but also his legs. Sixteen years later, now head of the Gu Corporation, he vows to find the girl who once saved him and make her his wife.
